messages.subject: Re: Can you fix the download links of the NBLAST data?
messages.subject_clean: Can you fix the download links of the NBLAST data?
messages.body_plain:
Hi Hideo,

Nice to hear from you. I'm sorry for the broken links - we will try to
fix soon with a permanent doi url. In the meantime, you can get the data
as follows (see https://github.com/jefferis/flycircuit and note that
this will take a while):

# install required packages
if(!require('devtools'))
devtools::install_github("jefferis/flycircuit", dependencies=TRUE)

# get flycircuit neurons
devtools::source_gist("bbaf5d53353b3944c090")

# get processed GMR images
library(flycircuit)
gmrdps<-read.neuronlistfh("http://flybrain.mrc-lmb.cam.ac.uk/si/nblast/gmrdps/gmrdps.rds",
localdir=getOption('flycircuit.datadir'))
remotesync(gmrdps, download.missing = TRUE)

The question is what format you will need for your front end? In the
download above you will get one R object for each neuron in R's rds
format. When you read the file into R you will get R dotprops objects
(see http://jefferis.github.io/nat/reference/dotprops.html).

Best,

Greg.
